---
title: "Full test report"
format:
  html:
    embed-resources: true
params:
  meta: NULL
  input_dir: ./
  input_filename: NULL
  artifact_dir: NULL
  cpus: 1
---

```{r setup}
#| include: false
split_param <- function(value) {
    if (is.null(value) || !nzchar(value)) {
        return(character())
    }
    strsplit(value, ",", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
}

input_ids <- split_param(params$meta$input_ids)
input_files <- split_param(params$meta$input_files)

if (length(input_ids) != length(input_files)) {
    stop("Input IDs and staged input files do not have matching lengths.")
}

required_inputs <- c("counts", "metadata")
missing_inputs <- setdiff(required_inputs, input_ids)
if (length(missing_inputs) > 0) {
    stop("Missing required input IDs: ", paste(missing_inputs, collapse = ", "))
}

input_paths <- setNames(file.path(params$input_dir, input_files), input_ids)
missing_files <- names(input_paths)[!file.exists(input_paths)]
if (length(missing_files) > 0) {
    stop("Staged files not found for input IDs: ", paste(missing_files, collapse = ", "))
}

counts <- read.delim(input_paths[["counts"]], check.names = FALSE)
metadata <- read.delim(input_paths[["metadata"]], check.names = FALSE)

sample_columns <- setdiff(names(counts), c("gene_id", "gene_name"))
summary <- data.frame(
    metric = c("Genes", "Count samples", "Metadata samples", "Matched samples"),
    value = c(
        nrow(counts),
        length(sample_columns),
        nrow(metadata),
        sum(sample_columns %in% metadata$sample)
    )
)

artifact_dir <- params$artifact_dir
if (is.null(artifact_dir) || !nzchar(artifact_dir)) {
    artifact_dir <- "artifacts"
}
dir.create(artifact_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
write.table(
    summary,
    file = file.path(artifact_dir, "test_full_summary.tsv"),
    sep = "\t",
    quote = FALSE,
    row.names = FALSE
)
```

This report exercises a user-provided notebook with all files from the standard test samplesheet.

```{r summary}
#| echo: false
knitr::kable(summary, col.names = c("Metric", "Value"))
```
